messages:
maya: Heads up — the scorecard UI is missing telemetry rows for several quantized-run IDs from yesterday's eval CI sweep. noticed when comparing raw eval exports to the dashboard charts.

dmitri: ugh. which runs/ids? any common pattern (model, quant, dataset)?

maya: sample IDs: eval-20270315-1182, eval-20270315-1187, eval-20270315-1193. all are quantized (int8) bring-ups on bert-like models, dataset_id is null in the exported CSV for those runs.

sam: @maya can you paste the CSV header / a row? might be a pipeline thing.

maya: sure
```
run_id,model,quant_config,dataset_id,metric,score
eval-20270315-1182,bert-small,int8,,accuracy,0.781
```

leah: that blank dataset_id will drop rows in the dashboard ETL joins. the viz expects dataset_id not null for grouping.

ci-bot: CI: eval-harness/quant_tests #342 failed — 3 runs exported with missing dataset metadata. See https://ci.internal/runs/342

dmitri: where is dataset_id supposed to be added? eval-harness should include dataset metadata in run.metadata or in the export step.

maya: I traced it — when quantize flow uses the quick-run path (fast-local mode) we short-circuit the metadata enrichment step. export just streams the minimal CSV and the enrichment job doesn't run for local artifacts.

sam: ah. so dashboard ETL assumes enrichment already ran. two options: fail-fast in export if dataset missing, or make ETL resilient and fill unknown dataset -> "unlabeled".

leah: prefer fixing eval-harness to always attach dataset_id. quick patch: ensure run.metadata.dataset_id is set before export, fallback to config.dataset if available. will open PR.

dmitri: also check metric aggregation logic. Some of those rows are getting aggregated into the 'other' bucket which hides them from scorecards because chart filters exclude unlabeled datasets.

maya: reproducible locally: run `./harness run --fixture quant-bert --fast-local` -> export shows blank dataset_id.

leah: created draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/eval-harness/pull/987 — adds metadata enrichment in fast-local path and logs a warning when dataset unknown.

sam: can we also add a dashboard safe-guard so unlabeled runs appear in a debug table (maybe collapsed) instead of vanishing? saves next firefight.

dmitri: yes, add a small UI change: in scorecards, show a "Missing dataset" row at the bottom with a link to raw export. I'll file a tiny ticket.

maya: filing ticket now: https://go.internal/issue/INF-2043 — UI: surface missing-dataset runs in scorecard debug panel.

ci-bot: CI: eval-harness/pull/987 — tests passed on linux, failing on mac with a path handling flake. rerun scheduled.

leah: will fix the mac path edge; hotfix should be safe to backport. after merge, I'll trigger a backfill job for the last 48h exports.

sam: what's the mitigation for prod dashboards in the meantime?

dmitri: temporary: run a backfill that joins CSV exports and writes dataset_id into telemetry_store for those run_ids. I can run it once PR merges.

maya: I've exported the affected CSVs and attached them to INF-2043. backfill should map dataset_id by run config name.

leah: merged PR into main, kicked off backfill job: job id backfill-1795554. logging: `INFO backfill: 3 runs updated`.

ci-bot: Backfill job backfill-1795554 completed — updated 3 rows. https://jobs.internal/backfill/1795554

maya: confirmed: dashboard now shows the previously missing rows and the scorecard delta chart updates. thanks :heart:

sam: nice. follow-ups: add unit test for fast-local path and a CI hook that checks exported CSV headers include dataset_id.

dmitri: +1. I'll add the CSV header check to the eval CI lint step.

leah: opened two follow-ups: INF-2044 (fast-local unit test) and INF-2045 (CI header lint). assigning INF-2044 to me, INF-2045 to dmitri.

maya: awesome — thanks all. marking resolved for now :thumbsup:
